facts.text: Brentwood Mansion built in 1817 by Robert Brent, first mayor, later burned in 1917.
Neighborhood boundaries include Rhode Island Ave NE, train tracks of Rhode Island Ave–Brentwood Metro station, Montana Ave NE, New York Ave NE.
The area south of Brentwood borders Gallaudet University, whose landscaped campus and cultural activities give the neighborhood a distinct academic vibe.
The Rhode Island Ave–Brentwood Metro station is the neighborhood’s transit hub, drawing steady foot traffic and anchoring nearby retail like Brentwood Square Shopping Center.
The original Brentwood estate stayed in the Brent/Pearson/Patterson/Winslow family for over 150 years before evolving into the dense urban community we see today.
The neighborhood’s name honors the Brentwood Mansion, a grand estate that once stretched farther than the current borders, symbolizing the area’s transition from single estate to multi‑use community.
